description: FNAS-LCD: copy an uploaded dataset onto SDSC Expanse (Tapis downloads the archive into the job's folder and the job unpacks it there), or delete one. Submitted by the FNAS-LCD service with each user's own login.

appArgs.name: mode
appArgs.description: src/training/expanse_job.py's mode: "upload" unpacks the archive input into dataset/ in the job's folder; "delete <upload job id>" deletes the folder of an upload made by the same Tapis user.

containerArgs.name: start-folder
containerArgs.description: Start in /app, so the image's entrypoint.sh runs.

containerArgs.name: datasets
containerArgs.description: Every upload job's folder, as /datasets/<upload job id>, for delete.

schedulerOptions.name: allocation
schedulerOptions.description: The Expanse allocation ICICLE's services charge their jobs to.

schedulerOptions.name: singularity-cache
schedulerOptions.description: Keep converted images in the shared cache in harvest's scratch space.

fileInputs.name: archive
fileInputs.description: The dataset as a plain tar; the service gives a temporary link to it.
